ranked.method:
Full PPR, Week 7 2026. The script is /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-jz-kit/8f34411e-cae9-5317-988c-4b9094bb09b9/scratchpad/te7/work/proj.py, and the consensus step is in .../te7/work/final3.py.

(1) Usage baseline: U = 0.5*ep_pg + 0.3*ppg3 + 0.2*ppg, all from te_table.csv. When ppg3 is missing, the weights are rescaled.

(2) Matchup: A = U * sqrt(opp_te_ppg_allowed/13.3) * sqrt(implied/22.5). Implied totals come from the table; they match the nflverse Week 7 lines, e.g. DET 28.25 from DET -3 with a total of 53.5.

(3) Vegas:
- No TE had both a receptions line and a yards line, so the 50% weight was never used. Loveland had only a yards line (44.5, BetMGM).
- For players with anytime-TD odds (25% weight): convert each price to implied probability, average across books, and divide by 1.05 to strip about 5% vig. That gives p.
- Because rec/yds lines are missing, the TD-only Vegas projection is V = A - 6*(season TD/gp)*M + 6*p. In words: the usage line with its season TD rate swapped for the market TD probability.
- P = 0.75*A + 0.25*V, which is the same as A + 1.5*(p - TDrate*M).
- Kittle's -105 (StatPick, no book named, flagged unreliable) was not used. Everyone without odds has 0% Vegas weight.

(4) Injuries:
- Players named as questionable, or carrying an injury into Week 7 per a 2026 source, get -15%: Hockenson (concussion, 'questionable' per Legion Report), Warren (groin; Q on the Week 6 report and missed Week 6), Freiermuth (calf; Q in Week 6). The last two are not confirmed official Week 7 statuses.
- Kraft is flagged ('wait for injury report', RotoBaller) but no injury is named, so no haircut.

(5) Consensus check:
- Average rank across 8 Week 7 lists, with n shown. FP = FantasyPros ECR, Oct 20, 2 experts, ranks 1-12; Henry, Andrews, Mayer and J. Ferguson come from FP half-PPR ECR. DS = Draft Sharks PPR, Oct 20. FBG = Footballguys Week 7. RB = RotoBaller half-PPR. SI = SI on Yahoo, top 4. Huddle = USA Today/TheHuddle, top 3. Fantrax = FantraxHQ, top 4. BR = Bleacher Report PPR, top 4.
- The gap is measured against consensus order: the rank of that average among startable TEs in this pool. A player in none of the top-20 lists counts as consensus >=21.
- Where my rank differed by more than 4 and the data did not clearly support it, I blended the projection toward the projection sitting at the consensus slot, in 10% steps, until the gap was <=4. The weight w used is given in 'why'.
- Only Warren's gap was kept as clearly supported: injury plus the stingiest TE defense plus a 17.5 team total.

(6) Ranked by the final projection. Tiers: T1 is ranks 1-6 (13.7-16.3), T2 is 7-10 (9.4-12.2), T3 is 11-17 (8.7-9.2), T4 is 18-20 (absent from every consensus top 20).

(7) Floor and ceiling are the 20th and 80th percentiles of a gamma distribution with mean = projection. The CV comes from 2026 weekly TE scoring (stats_wk.csv), corrected for small samples: 0.44 for >=7 tgt/g, 0.74 for 5-7, 0.84 for <5, plus 0.10 if a haircut applied.

Bottom line: the same six TEs top every list (Kittle, LaPorta, Kraft, McBride, Bowers, Likely). Start any of them. My order only reshuffles them by matchup, and they are within 2.6 points of each other.

I couldn't collect any data. My first three WebSearch queries (Dalton Schultz Week 7 injury, Harold Fannin Jr. Browns Week 7, Hunter Henry Patriots injury) all came back saying search was not performed because this turn's web search limit of 200 calls is used up. That limit is shared by every agent in the run. The tool said not to get around it with curl, wget, search engines, readers or proxies, so I stopped searching. I did not reach the 15 queries the task asked for.

None of the 15 tight ends has a confirmed Week 7 injury status, Wednesday practice report, role news, team or QB situation. Every field is marked "not found" or "not verified" so nothing is made up from training knowledge, which could be out of date for October 2026. The only known facts are the ones already in the task: Week 7 byes are BUF, JAX, LAC and WAS, scoring is full PPR, and the week runs Thu Oct 22 to Mon Oct 26.

To finish this research, the user can send a follow-up message to start a new turn with a fresh search budget, or raise CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION. Any start/sit ranking built from this output should say plainly that injury and role data for these players is missing.
